headline: Iran Fires 35-40 Missiles at Jordan Base, Seizes US Drone in Hormuz
subheadline: Jordan intercepts all Iranian ballistic missiles over Amman and Azraq with zero casualties while IRGC captures US underwater vehicle in Strait of Hormuz.
lede: Iran launched its largest direct missile attack since the ceasefire, firing an estimated 35-40 ballistic missiles from Yazd and Lorestan toward King Faisal Air Base in Jordan targeting US forces, while Jordanian air defenses intercepted all missiles over Amman, Azraq, Mafraq, and northern Jordan with no reported casualties. Concurrently, IRGC forces seized a US unmanned underwater vehicle in the Strait of Hormuz and downed a US MQ-1 drone over Bandar Abbas, as US forces reportedly struck Iranian tankers at Kharg and Jask islands for a second time. Iran warned any further attacks on its tankers will trigger retaliation against US bases and interests across the region.

sections.title: Russia Strikes Kyiv Infrastructure, Sets Donetsk Deadline
sections.body: Russia struck Kyiv with massive drone and missile attacks on September 8, killing 5 and wounding 20+, hitting civilian infrastructure including a TV channel during broadcast and pharmacy warehouses. Multiple Shahed drones launched from Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Zaporizhzhia directions targeted Kyiv, Boryspil, Vasylkiv, and Brovary. Russia set a new deadline for capturing Donetsk region by end of March 2027, its 15th deadline shift, while DTEK power stations were knocked offline after multi-wave attacks.

sections.title: Iran Missile Barrage, US Drone Seizure Escalate Tensions
sections.body: Iran fired an estimated 35-40 ballistic missiles including possible Khorramshahr-3/4 with cluster munitions from Yazd and other locations toward King Faisal Air Base in Jordan targeting US forces and aircraft. Jordanian air defenses intercepted all Iranian missiles over Amman, Azraq, Mafraq, and northern Jordan with no casualties or debris in residential areas. IRGC seized a US Navy unmanned underwater vehicle in the Strait of Hormuz and shot down a US MQ-1 attack drone over Bandar Abbas, while US forces attacked Iranian tankers at Kharg Island and Jask port for a second time.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran has demonstrated a significant escalation in both scale and directness of its military posture, conducting its largest missile barrage since the ceasefire directly targeting a US-hosting base in Jordan while simultaneously seizing a US naval drone in the Strait of Hormuz and downing a US reconnaissance drone over its territory. The coordinated multi-axis pressure creates a dangerous action-reaction cycle with US tanker strikes, while Jordan's successful interception confirms it as a forward battleground. Russia's sustained multi-axis drone campaigns targeting Kyiv and energy infrastructure, combined with its shifting Donetsk deadlines, indicate continued offensive planning despite Ukraine's energy vulnerabilities.
